name: MoneyPrinterTurbo
description: 利用 AI 大模型和自动化工作流，根据主题或关键词一键生成高清短视频。Generate HD short videos from a topic or keyword with an automated AI workflow.
one_liner: Type a topic or a few keywords and it automatically writes a script, finds matching video clips, adds subtitles and background music, then outputs a finished short video — no editing skills needed.
buyer: A small business owner or solo social media manager who needs a steady stream of short-form video content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) but has no time or budget for a video editor.
business_use_cases: A local real estate agent generates daily 'market tip' short videos to post on Instagram Reels without hiring a video editor.
An e-commerce seller batch-produces product-highlight videos from a spreadsheet of keywords for each item in their catalog.
A content agency offers 'unlimited short videos' as a cheap add-on service to small business clients by running this tool at scale.

money_ideas.idea: Run a done-for-you short video subscription service for local businesses, delivering a batch of ready-to-post videos each week.
Sell a simplified hosted UI on top of it and charge per video generated for users who don't want to run the Python project themselves.

steal_this: This weekend, wire up a Google Sheet of business names and keywords to this tool so a small agency can generate a week's worth of short videos for ten clients in one batch run.
